Question 7
?

The graph above shows the function y=f(x), defined on [−4,4]. Find the intervals on which the function f(x) is concave up.

a
(−1,1) only
b
(−4,1) and (−1,4)
c
(−4,−1) and (1,4)
d
(1,4) only
e
(−4,−1) only
